title.narrative: Ha Noi Metro Rail System Project (Line 3: Nhon-Ha Noi Station Section)

description.narrative: The Project will establish an integrated sustainable public transport system in six districts of Ha Noi by constructing 12.5 kilometers of a dual track rail metro line from Nhon to Ha Noi railway station. The Project will develop a new double track metro rail line in Ha Noi, which is one of four priority lines of a planned larger urban transportation system under the Ha Noi Urban Transport Master Plan (HUTMP). Metro line 3 will (i) facilitate public transport connectivity, (ii) greatly enhance access in six districts of Ha Noi, and (iii) be an an important integral part of an improved public transport system, which aims to achieve increased public modal share through low-carbon transport that reduces greenhouse gas emissions.

title.narrative: Loan 2741: 85% of contracts awarded and 55% disbursed as of 23 Apr 2025
Loan 3363: 0% of contracts awarded and 1% disbursed as of 23 Apr 2025
Loan 3364: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 23 Apr 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Achievement of outcome indicators will be delayed since the opening of the elevated section is expected by end of December 2022, while the opening of the entire line (and underground section) is expected only in 2027.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40080/40080-013-apfs-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jun 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/40080/40080-013-smr-en_41.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: As of 30 June 2022, the project's overall physical progress has only achieved 69.3% vs. the planned progress of 99.6%.
Package CP01 Elevated Section/Line (Viaduct): The civil works for the viaduct were completed at end of 2019 pending taking over by MRB.
Package CP02 Elevated Stations: The civil works for elevated stations is almost completed (99.7%).
Package CP03 Tunnel and Underground Stations: (32.3%). The contract was suspended at the beginning of August 2021, and on 31 October 2021, the CP03 contractor issued a notice of contract termination. Termination has not been effective yet. Negotiation on the resumption of works is ongoing.
Package CP04 Infrastructure Works at Depot: Completed.
Package CP05 Architectural Works (building) at Depot: The progress has remained very slow (77.3%). This represents great issue and concern for the elevated section opening expected by end of December 2022.
Package CP06 -1st rail system (rolling stock): (87.8%). All 10 trains arrived in Vietnam and have been assembled. For dynamic tests, trains operated at full speed in automatic mode between Station 1 and Station 8.
Package CP07 - 2nd rail system (E&M): (45.2%). The works were suspended since April 2021 due to the absence of payments for EOT. The contractor recently agreed to stop the suspension and remobilize its team.
Package CP08 - 3rd rail system (trackworks) (73.2%): Tracks for the elevated section are largely complete, whereas the tracks for the tunnel section will be delayed significantly due to the delayed tunnel construction.
CP09 - Automated Fare Collection: (62.6%).
Almost MRB staff meet minimum skills criteria of their positions.
However, MRB has not arranged qualified and experienced environmental officer and occupational health and safety officer, to comply with the Loan Agreement.
